subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the authority for the presenter's hand only: the same woman's right hand and the light-blue T-shirt sleeve.
<Picture 2> is the authority for the back label: the 2-litre white milk bottle with blue cap and handle, and its white back label with the purple heading, the purple cow illustrations, the nutrition table, and the ingredient lines near the bottom left.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer. Only her hand, skin tone and T-shirt sleeve carry over; her face is not in this shot.
<Picture 2>: fully_preserved for the back label. Keep the label layout, purple heading, cow illustrations, nutrition table and ingredient lines exactly as shown, crisp and never garbled, re-lettered or invented. Its white studio background does not carry over.

detailed_description:
A locked vertical close-up insert in the kitchen. Exactly one hand is in frame for the whole shot: her right hand holds the bottle from <Picture 2> by its handle and presents the back label to the lens, the label filling most of the frame, the marble island softly blurred behind. Her other hand never appears. Her off-screen voice speaks in a clear, reminding tone, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 他家的奶，你看配料表，</d> as the same hand slowly tilts the bottle a little closer to the camera so the lower label area is easy to read, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 就只有牛奶一样，</d> then eases it back and holds it perfectly steady, label square to the lens, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 还没有添加剂。</d>

soundscape: her close off-screen Mandarin voice, a faint plastic creak from the bottle handle, quiet kitchen room tone. No music.

Only one hand in frame, never a second hand, no pointing finger, no extra fingers, no distorted hand or nails. No subtitles, captions, watermarks or text other than the back label already in <Picture 2>; the label must stay sharp and unchanged. No other products, no other milk bottles or cartons, no other brands. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement.
4:
subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the authority for the presenter: the same woman, face, short black hair in a low bun, light-blue plain T-shirt, bright modern kitchen.
<Picture 2> is the authority for the product: the 2-litre white plastic milk bottle with blue screw cap, handle, and green a2 front label, full of fresh white milk. It is the only product in this shot.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: identity_preserved. Face, hair, outfit and kitchen carry over.
<Picture 2>: attribute_transfer. Bottle shape, blue cap, handle, green front label and the plain white milk carry over; its white background does not.

detailed_description:
A vertical selfie-style medium shot at chest height. The white marble island in front of her is clear except for one empty clear drinking glass. She holds the single bottle from <Picture 2> by its handle, already uncapped, and says earnestly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 要知道他家的奶天然不含A一蛋白，</d> then tilts the bottle and pours a smooth steady stream of white milk into the glass, the glass filling about three-quarters, and while pouring says clearly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 每百毫升蛋白质就有三点三克。</d> She sets the bottle down on the island, front label toward the lens, and lifts the full glass toward the camera with a satisfied smile.

soundscape: her clear close-mic Mandarin voice, the gentle glug of milk pouring into glass, quiet kitchen room tone. No music.

The only product anywhere in frame is this one 2-litre bottle from <Picture 2>. No milk cartons, no paper drink boxes, no tetra packs, no cardboard boxes, no other bottles, packaging or brands on the island or in the background. No subtitles, captions, watermarks or extra text; the only printing is the front label from <Picture 2>, kept stable. The milk stream is continuous, never spilling or splashing out of the glass; milk level only rises. No extra fingers, no distorted hands or face. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement beyond slight handheld sway.
